_comment: Vesiputket (games/vesiputket): the water and sand game's clips; the Finnish ones are in voice/fi.json.

clips.vp_kukka: Dig a tunnel through the hill and open the tap. The flower needs water!
clips.vp_nuotio: A campfire is burning in the cave. Dig a way for the water past the rock and put out the fire!
clips.vp_allas: The duck wants to swim. Build a pipe over the gap so the water reaches the pool.
clips.vp_hiekka: Dig holes in the shelves so the sand pours into the sandbox.
clips.vp_kaksi: Two flowers are waiting for water. Dig a way to both of them!
clips.vp_silta: Fill the pit with sand so the water reaches the flower.
clips.vp_leikki: Free play! Try water, sand, pipes and fire.
clips.vp_tyhja: The tank is empty. Try again!
